newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania average one-week rate unchanged at 49 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania average one-week rate unchanged at 49 pct.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Friday the average accepted rate for its one-week funds stayed flat at 49 percent at this week's refinancing auction.
The BNR's offer of 1.35 trillion lei was slightly oversubscribed with six commercial banks entering 1.355 trillion worth of bids at prices equal with its minimum permitted rate.
On Thursday, the central bank raised by one percentage point to 49 percent the minimum permitted rate and cut by 200 billion lei to 1.35 trillion the amount of funds available.
Prices for leu funds up to one-week hovered near 34 percent on a stalled money market, inundated with lei.
